protocol_note: Per project protocol, V1 is evaluated on the complete later.csv dataset (300 rows) and also checked on the chronological final 30% segment (90 rows), while V2 is trained on cleaned train.csv + first 70% chronological later.csv (1210 rows) and evaluated on the chronological final 30% of later.csv (90 rows). Because complete later.csv and its final 30% segment are different evaluation splits, both comparisons are reported transparently.
